parameters.subject: ={{ 'Join request limit reached: ' + $('Normalize Email').item.json.task.title }}
parameters.message:
={{ `Hello ${$('Normalize Email').item.json.task.creator.name},

Thank you for your request. The daily limit of 10 automatically generated Join tickets has already been reached, so no ticket was created for this email. Please try again tomorrow.

Best regards,
Join Team` }}

parameters.content:
## Setup required
1. Connect `8245oleg@gmail.com` through Gmail OAuth2 in every Gmail node, including `Send Limit Reply`.
2. Receive stakeholder requests through `8245oleg+join@gmail.com`.
3. Create the labels `erledigt` and `zu bearbeiten` in Gmail.
4. Select those labels in the matching Add Label nodes.
5. The first 10 received requests per Berlin calendar day create tickets; later requests receive an automatic limit reply.
6. Test with non-sensitive sample mail before activation.

Credentials are intentionally excluded from this export.
